title: core/contracts.py imports jsonschema but it was not a declared dependency
body: core/contracts.py:26 and core/schema_validator.py:28 import jsonschema, but it was absent from pyproject dependencies; the language-rule gate (diff-scoped) surfaced it when core/contracts.py was edited for BI-PF-1267.

rcca.root_cause: jsonschema was adopted by the contract/schema validators without being added to the declared dependency set (pyproject) or the tool catalog (BI-PF-0443).
rcca.corrective: Declared jsonschema>=4.0.0 in pyproject dependencies and added its tool-catalog entry (MIT, permissive, bundled).
rcca.preventive: The change-scoped undeclared-dep gate + dependency-catalog gate now cover it; any new import must be declared and catalogued.
